description: Of about 420 million travellers CBP processed at ports of entry in FY2024, 12,660,784 - roughly 3% - were referred to secondary inspection.

aspect: Referral needs no suspicion at all
description: Officers at primary have broad discretion to refer with or without any suspicion of wrongdoing. Listed grounds include document issues, possible violations, an alert - and explicitly 'random screening' and 'officer discretion'.
energy_note: No reason is required, and none will be given.

aspect: THE HONEST GAP - no per-nationality rate is published
description: No government publishes a secondary-inspection rate broken down by nationality. The headline 3% also pools hundreds of millions of routine land crossings, so it says almost nothing about the rate for any specific profile. The disparity Mexicans report is consistent and unmeasured.
energy_note: Everyone reports it; nobody counts it.
notes: Same treatment as AIR-001 in assets/text/nigeria and the Palestine dataset. Recorded as a gap, not asserted.

aspect: EXAMPLE - device searches are rarer than the fear of them
description: CBP searched the devices of 47,047 travellers in FY2024 - about 0.3% of those sent to secondary, under 0.01% of all arrivals - rising to roughly 55,000 in FY2025. About 90% were basic manual searches. CBP states device access is not a purpose of secondary referral.
energy_note: Rare, and it does not feel rare.

aspect: The cost is the connection, not the question
description: Two hours in the room means the onward flight, the shift, the hire car, the hotel night. Nobody reimburses any of it and no finding of wrongdoing is ever made.
energy_note: No charge, no apology, and the flight is gone.

aspect: It reshapes how he travels for the rest of his life
description: Arriving six hours early, never booking tight connections, carrying a folder of proof nobody asks for, flying on Tuesdays. An unpriced tax on every future journey.
energy_note: Six hours early, every time, for the rest of his life.

aspect: What the second room actually is
description: Rows of bolted chairs, no clock, phones surrendered or forbidden, no explanation of expected duration, and no one to ask. The design communicates that his time is not a cost to anybody.
energy_note: No clock on the wall, deliberately.

aspect: He will not mention it to the people meeting him
description: Explaining a four-hour delay to a waiting family means explaining being suspected, so most people say the flight was late.
energy_note: Tells them the flight was late.
